name: [NOW] Catch and Feed a Brainrot!
desc:
Catch a Brainrot -> Feed it -> Watch It Evolve!
Level up, earn cash, and unlock insane evolutions!

💰 Grows offline forever!

Updates at 11AM EST Every week!

How it works
1. Equip your lasso tool 🤠
2. Walk up to a Brainrot 🧠
3. Interact with the prompt to start a battle 💥

How to gift items:
1. Hold out a fruit or relic 🏺
2. Walk up to someone 🚶
3. Hold E to give it to them! 🎁
